name: Sorcerers
overview: Scripture clearly condemns sorcery and all forms of occult practices, warning believers to avoid those who engage with familiar spirits or wizardry, as these defile and oppose the holiness of God. The Old Testament commands that witches not be allowed to live, demonstrating the severity of this sin. Furthermore, the New Testament warns that sorcerers will face eternal judgment, sharing in the lake of fire reserved for the unrepentant. These passages emphasize that sorcery is incompatible with a life devoted to Christ and must be firmly rejected by believers.
